name: Onboarding
description: This is where we lay the groundwork. Sign the agreement, pay, fill out the onboarding form, get access to the tools, and choose where your community will live. No work begins until this stage is done — because shortcuts here create leaks everywhere else. When this stage is done, you're set up to move fast — no more guessing, no more setup drag.
exitCriteria: Agreement signed. First payment in. GHL access confirmed. Community platform chosen. Onboarding form submitted.

name: System Install
description: This is the engine. Three phases: Lead Capture (who comes in), Nurture (how you build trust), and Conversion (how they say yes). We install your lead capture, nurture, and conversion pathway inside GoHighLevel. You show up with the raw materials — your ideal lead, your offer, your voice, your stories. We build the engine. This track runs in parallel with Community.
entryCriteria: Onboarding complete. Offer clarified. Baseline metrics captured.
exitCriteria: Lead capture live. Nurture sequence approved. Conversion pathway mapped. Offer, price, and next steps locked in.

name: Community
tagline: Build a real community — not an audience.
description: Audiences watch. Communities buy. Three phases: Foundation (set it up right), Seed (fill it with the right people), and Rhythm (keep it alive). This is where you build the space, seed it with your warm people, and establish a rhythm that keeps it alive. This track runs in parallel with System Install.
exitCriteria: Platform live. First members in. Posting rhythm and rituals set. Community connected to the Omnichannel system.

name: Launch First Conversion Event
tagline: Run your first real conversion event.
description: This is the moment everything has been building toward — where both tracks (System Install + Community) come together. You deliver. You make the offer. You follow through. Capture the numbers. This is the truth-teller. Every leak in your system shows up here — and that's good, because now we can fix what's real.
entryCriteria: System Install and Community both complete. Event scheduled. Offer ready.
exitCriteria: Event delivered. Offer made. Follow-up sent. Buyers onboarded. Real numbers captured.

name: Optimize
tagline: Find the leak. Fix one thing. Run it again.
description: Optimize without data is just hoping. One event is a data point — now we turn it into a pattern. You debrief your first event, find where people dropped off, pick one thing to sharpen, and commit to event number two. Each cycle, you get better.
entryCriteria: First conversion event delivered with real numbers captured.
exitCriteria: Leak identified. One focused improvement committed. Next event scheduled. Non-buyers re-engaged. Wins captured.

name: Scale
description: One good event is a win. A reliable schedule of events is a business. You've proven it works — now you make it a machine. Set your event cadence. Build the content engine. Add new lead sources. Systematize community rituals. Document the playbook. Hire help where you need it. Introduce a higher-tier offer. Build retention. Not a sprint — you build these pillars over months.
entryCriteria: At least one optimize cycle complete. Results reviewed against goals.
exitCriteria: Event cadence set. Content engine running. Playbook documented. KPIs tracking in HelixOS. Retention + higher-tier offer in motion.

name: Ongoing Momentum
tagline: Stay in the work. Keep compounding.
description: This is where Academy earns its year. The work is never done — and that's the point. Weekly rhythms. Monthly reviews. Quarterly direction. You show up, you measure, you commit. Post wins. Help others. Share testimonials. Identify when you're ready for Elite or Luxe. The system keeps getting sharper — and so do you. This is the compounding stage.
entryCriteria: Scale pillars in motion. Event cycle running on schedule.
exitCriteria: Ongoing — no exit. Momentum stage runs for the life of the Academy engagement.
